title: Write and approve design versions
responsibility: Read verified design images, append a design version, or approve the exact current design content.

inputs.name: readImage.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: readImage.input
inputs.description: Unit ID, version and file, with optional revision, expected hash and option; revision defaults to HEAD.

inputs.name: planDesign.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planDesign.input
inputs.description: Unit, prompt and generator with images or options, optional notes and contract, base revision and revision source; expectedLatest enforces an optional latest-version check.

inputs.name: approve.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: approve.input
inputs.description: Latest unit/version, reviewer, contract hash, exact image bindings, optional notes hash and option selection.

outputs.name: readImage
outputs.description: Verified PNG bytes and image metadata, owning option when present, and version creation commit.

outputs.name: planDesign
outputs.description: Commit metadata and the appended sequential design version. Visual units require images; functions reject images; headless versions without images require notes.

outputs.name: approve
outputs.description: Commit metadata and the saved approval marked current after matching the latest version and exact content.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid input/images, stale versions, missing or changed artifacts, mismatched approvals and unsafe or dirty writes; Git failures propagate.
